chunks: And the Sheikh — may Allah the Exalted support him — informed me, from Abu al-Qasim Ja'far ibn Muhammad, from Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from Muhammad ibn Isma'il, from al-Fadl ibn Shadhan, from Safwan and 'Ali ibn Ibrahim from his father, from Hammad ibn 'Isa — all of them together — from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said: I heard Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him) say:
"When water reaches the measure of a kur, nothing renders it impure."
As for the narration transmitted by al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from 'Uthman ibn 'Isa, from Sama'a, from Abu Basir — he said:
I asked him about a kur of water that I passed by while traveling, in which a donkey, a mule, or a person had urinated. He said: "Do not perform wudu from it, and do not drink from it."
The intended meaning thereof is [the case] when its color, taste, or smell has changed — and that which indicates this [is as follows].

key_terms.طَهَارَةٌ: ritual purity (taharah) — the legal state required for acts of worship such as salat
key_terms.كُرٌّ: kur — a minimum volume of water (approx. 377–384 liters in Shia fiqh) beyond which nothing can render it ritually impure
key_terms.لَوْنٌ: color — the first of three properties (color, taste, smell) whose change in water indicates real impurity
key_terms.يُنَجِّسُ: to render ritually impure (najis) — a legal determination that a substance has been contaminated

ai.seo_question: What is the Shia jurisprudential ruling on kur water and under what conditions does it become najis according to Imam al-Sadiq (AS)?
ai.summary: This passage from Tahdhib al-Ahkam records Imam al-Sadiq's (AS) definitive ruling that water meeting or exceeding the kur measure cannot be rendered ritually impure (najis) by any contaminant. Sheikh al-Tusi then presents a seemingly contradictory hadith — in which Abu Basir reports that the Imam prohibited wudu and drinking from a kur of water urinated in by a donkey, mule, or person — and reconciles the apparent conflict by clarifying that the prohibition applies exclusively when the water's color, taste, or odor has been altered by the impurity.
